name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: An add-on toolkit that makes AI coding assistants like Claude Code work better and safer — giving them long-term memory, security checks, and pre-built skills.
buyer: A CTO at a startup whose engineering team relies heavily on Claude Code or Cursor daily and wants those tools to be more reliable and less likely to leak secrets or lose context.
business_use_cases: An engineering org standardizes every developer's AI coding setup on this to get consistent memory and security behavior across the team.
A dev-tools vendor integrates ECC's security scanning layer into their own AI coding product as a safety feature.
A consultancy sells 'AI coding agent hardening' audits to companies worried about agents leaking credentials or making risky changes, using this as part of the toolkit.

money_ideas.idea: The project already sells paid seats for private repos through its own GitHub App — that's the model: paid tiers for teams that need it on proprietary code.

steal_this: This is already a going commercial concern with a paid tier and GitHub App — the weekend opportunity is on the services side: offer a fixed-price 'install and configure ECC for your team' package to startups too busy to do it themselves.
